# The contract's tooling, for development and CI only. Pydantic is pinned exactly because its
# version decides how the contract is read, and so the IR and everything generated from it.

# The contract's operations are FastAPI routes (holder_contract.routes); pinned like Pydantic, because

# For the strategies (holder_contract.values) and the conformance tests, which call core through cffi.
hypothesis>=6.170,<7
cffi>=2,<3
# OpenAPI as YAML; pinned because it decides the generated bytes, as in api/rig/requirements.txt.
PyYAML==6.0.3
